claim: An endlessly spinning sector in Blood is a type 615 kSectorRotateMarked with an axis marker inside it, rx 7 (the level-start broadcast), retrigger on both waves and an asymmetric busy_time a/b that sets direction and speed; no key, push or wallpush. Only 6 such sectors stand in 3 campaign maps (E1M4, E3M2, E4M2); 88 in 14 maps counting the Death Wish, curated community and converted maps. As a turnstile door they come in pairs, usually counter-rotating, flanking one entrance, each carrying four grate-tile blade sprites (332) and a sound sprite beside one rotor.
evidence: E1M4 s151 and s314: type 615, rx_id 7, retrigger_a/b 1, busy_time_a 255 vs 0 (counter-rotating), marker_0 the axis
DWE1M9 s61 and s64: the same pair at busy 100/0 and 0/100, blades tile 332
88 instances in 14 maps, knowledge/blood/references/auto-rotators.json (reference view plus conversions; 6 of them campaign, recounted 2026-11-26)
use: For a turnstile or rotating scenery, copy the signature; start it from the level-start wire, not a switch. Decide door vs scenery by whether the rotor sits in a doorway with two portal walls.
